name: Kaori Cosme
description: An elegant, restrained store theme for a small clean-skincare atelier in Tokyo, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Lilac-grey pages, paper-white panels and ink-violet text and bands, with muted lilac kept to fine lines and small accents; Literata for headings and Mulish for text. A floating frosted pill header, a home page that opens on a full-bleed photograph, quiet glass-drop reflections on product cards, cells and dividers (soft CSS highlights, still for those who ask for less motion), the shelf of featured products, four ingredients (yuzu, rice, camellia, green tea), the morning and evening routines, the journal, and a one-line footer. Pages for home, shop, ingredients, routines, about, the journal, a seasonal newsletter and contact, plus shop, product, cart, checkout, account, order confirmation and product search templates (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the shelf and orders go by phone or email). The atelier address and hours, and the shelf with its prices and badge, live in two synced patterns, so each is edited once.
deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and header, footer and layout codes are as planned (#F3EEF7 #B7A6D9 #2D2A3E, Literata + Mulish, clean + luxe, H10 + F3 + L1; the combination is unused). Kept quiet at the user's request: muted lilac #B7A6D9 is only used for fine lines, the glass-drop marks and small accents (1.9:1, never for text); lilac accent text uses the deeper #65568F (5.6:1 on the ground), quiet text #5E5873 (5.9:1). A paper white #FCFBFD and a lilac haze #E7E0EF were added for panels.

fonts.role: headings, product names, prices and the lead paragraphs
body text, labels, the menu and buttons

store.withoutPlugin: The shop page shows the shelf of featured products with their prices, and orders go by phone or email; store templates are not used.
